# Børne- og ungdomspsykiatrisk ambulatorium i Odense

Børne- og ungdomspsykiatrisk ambulatorium i Odense is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic operating under [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] that reports its ADHD-related quality outcomes to the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]][^src8]. Across two consecutive reporting years the clinic emerges as one of the better-performing units in Denmark's ADHD quality monitoring system, repeatedly landing at or near the 90% development target set for several diagnostic-process indicators, while also showing weaker results on other measures — a pattern that illustrates the broader unevenness documented across Danish child and adolescent psychiatry in this period.

In the ADHD-databasen report covering 01.04.2023–31.03.2024, the Odense clinic is highlighted as "meget tæt på at nå standarden med somatisk udredning" ("very close to reaching the standard for somatic assessment"), completing somatic assessment in 89% of its 175 assessment pathways (156 out of 175 courses) [^src1][^src14]. On Indicator 2b — a manualised diagnostic interview or clinical environmental observation — the clinic performed exceptionally well, reaching 98% completion across 174 assessment pathways (171 of 174), making it "som den eneste afdeling" ("the only department") to meet the standard on that indicator that year [^src2][^src12]. The same report period also names Odense, alongside Aabenraa, Vejle, and BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn in Midtjylland, as meeting the standard for Indicator 2a [^src12].

Performance was more mixed on other indicators in the same 2023 report. On Indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences), Odense achieved only 37% compliance among its 175 assessment pathways (64 of 175 cases) [^src2]. On Indicator 4 (coordinating network meetings), the clinic recorded 64% compliance (51 of 80 cases, 95% CI 52–74) [^src3], a figure singled out in the report as the high end of a national range running "fra 1 % ... til 64 %" ("from 1%... to 64%"), with the low end attributed to [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-unge|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge i Midtjylland]] [^src4]. On Indicator 5 (psychoeducation), Odense reported a markedly lower rate — 10 of 80 cases, or 13% (95% CI 6–22) [^src4].

In the following year's report, covering 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, Odense's Indicator 1 (somatic assessment) result rose to 90% (192 of 204 cases, 95% CI 90–97), placing it among the departments meeting the standard alongside PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa), which reached 91% [^src5][^src15]. Indicator 2b results were reported at 94% [^src5][^src16], though on Indicator 3 the clinic's compliance dropped to 37% (76 of 206 cases, 95% CI 30–44) [^src16]. Indicator 4 stood at 50% (53 of 107 cases, 95% CI 40–59) [^src6], while other related measures for that year showed lower figures: 10% (11 of 107 cases, 95% CI 5–18) [^src7] and 57% (61 of 107 cases, 95% CI 47–67) with a further breakdown showing 0% on a related sub-measure [^src8]. Additional entries for this period show a reported 100% (95% CI 3–100) on one small-sample indicator [^src9] and 0% (95% CI 0–98) on another [^src10], alongside a listing with no accompanying figures [^src11].

Taken together, the record positions Odense's Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium as a comparatively strong performer within Region Syddanmark on the somatic assessment and diagnostic-interview indicators that define the core of Denmark's national ADHD quality standard, even as it — like nearly every department in the country — falls well short of the 90% target on indicators covering diagnostic conferences, network coordination, and psychoeducation.
